External Parameters Implementation Plan

Overview

Implement phase-aware external parameter retrieval to support both pre- and post-per-unit conversion retrieval.

Implementation Steps

1. Core Types

  • Add RetrievalPhase abstract type: PrePerUnit, PostPerUnit
  • Update ExtParam struct to include phase::RetrievalPhase field
  • Add phase parameter to ExtParam constructor

2. Metadata Updates

  • Update PQ_EXT_PARAMS: add PrePerUnit() to ide and basekv
  • Update PV_EXT_PARAMS: add PrePerUnit() to ide and basekv
  • Update BRANCH_EXT_PARAMS: add PrePerUnit() to basekv
  • Update TRANSFORMER_EXT_PARAMS: add PrePerUnit() to basekv

3. Retrieval Infrastructure

  • Create retrieve_external_params(models, metadata_registry, phase) function
  • Filter ext_params by phase and retrieve values
  • Return NamedTuple structure: (PQ=(bus_ide=...,), PV=(...), ...)

4. SystemModel

  • Add ext_params::NamedTuple field
  • Update constructor to call retrieval in two phases:
    • PrePerUnit: before per-unit conversion
    • PostPerUnit: after per-unit conversion
  • Merge results from both phases

5. SystemResidualWorkspace

  • Add model_ext_params::NamedTuple field
  • Update constructor to copy from sys.ext_params
  • Handle CPU/GPU array conversion if needed

6. Residual Evaluation

  • Update evaluate_system_residuals! to pass ext_params
  • Update evaluate_model_residuals! signature: add ext_params parameter
  • Update calc_residuals! for all models: add ext_params::NamedTuple parameter

7. Model Kernels

  • PQ: Add ext_params.bus_ide masking for slack bus
  • PV: Add ext_params.bus_ide masking for slack bus
  • Branch: Add ext_params.bus_ide masking for slack terminals
  • Transformer: Add ext_params.bus_ide masking for slack terminals
  • Bus: No changes needed (already handles slack)

8. Testing

  • Run power flow on IEEE 14-bus case
  • Verify convergence with slack bus masking
  • Check residual norms < 1e-6

Key Design Principles

  • Metadata-driven: phase specified in ExtParam definition
  • Single storage: all extparams in `sys.extparams` regardless of phase
  • Generic signature: calc_residuals!(ws, model, ext_params::NamedTuple)
  • No signature expansion: NamedTuple is generic container
